title: 2 Condos on Music Row - Sleeps 14, POOL & Parking
description:
Enjoy TWO centrally located condos on famous MUSIC ROW located side-by-side! Sleep 14 in total & has a unique Guitar-Shaped Pool. Includes 2 Free parking spots + Washer/Dryer in one unit.  If you love music, you'll love staying here. Located across the street from recording studios, labels and publishers - you never know who you may see! Walking distance to restaurants, bars & shopping. About 1 mile from downtown Broadway Bars. Close to Vanderbilt & Belmont! Outdoor seating & grill at the Pool.

The space
HIGHLIGHTS:

★ TWO Separate Condos, located side-by-side 
★ Sleeps up to 14 people
★ 3 Bedrooms 
★ 10 Beds - 1 King bed + 2 Queen beds + Full over Full Bunk Bed + Twin Trundle Bed + 2 Queen Sleeper Sofa + 2 Queen Air Mattress
★ 2 spacious full-size bathroom with 3 separate sections for the toilet, standing shower and bathtub, and vanity area with double sinks 
★ Fully equipped, updated kitchen for all your cooking needs 
★ Smart TVs in all bedrooms & the living room, all with cable, YouTube TV + streaming apps 
★ Pool, outdoor patio furniture & grill (available seasonally) 
★ TWO Free designated covered parking spots + plenty of free street parking available 
★ Iconic, highly walkable location on Music Row - near restaurants, shopping, bars & live music
★ Near famous Midtown bars on Division St such as Winners, Loser, Red Door
★ In-unit washer & dryer + laundry supplies 
★ Hassle-free, keyless check-in and 24-hour access with personal code & elevator
★ Coffee makers + Coffee
★ High-speed internet
★ 1 mile to downtown Broadway Bars
★ Dressers and spacious closets with hangers for storing your belongings
★ Hair dryer, shampoo, conditioner, & body wash provided
★ Unique Guitar-shaped swimming pool, built by country music legend Webb Pierce
★ Next to famous music industry companies such as Warner Music Group, RCA Studio B recording studios, Warner-Chappell Music Publishing, ASCAP and many more.
★ Adjustable thermostats
★ Full-length Mirrors
★ Secure building with key-code entry
★ Elevator in the building

UNIT 1 BEDS:
Bedroom 1:  1 King bed + Smart TV 
Bedroom 2:  Full-over-Full Bunk Bed + Twin Trundle Bed + Smart TV
Common Area: 1 Queen Sleeper Sofa + 1 Queen Air Mattresses + Smart TV

UNIT 2 BEDS:
Bedroom 1: 2 Queen Beds
Common Area: 1 Queen Sleeper Sofas + 1 Queen Air Mattresses + Smart TV

UNIT 1 BATHROOMS: 
Full-size bathroom that has 3 sections to it: one with a double sink vanity & plenty of space to get ready, another area for the toilet, and a third section with a standing shower & a separate bathtub. 

UNIT 2 BATHROOMS: 
Full size with a standing shower - this spacious bathroom sits directly off of the bedroom and has 3 sections to it: one with a sink vanity & plenty of space to get ready, another area for the toilet, and a third section with a standing shower & a separate bathtub. 

This building neighbors some of Nashville’s most prominent record labels & publishing studios today, including Warner Music Group right across the street! You never know who you might bump into in this area. Walking distance from numerous live music spots, restaurants, bars, shops, and more – enjoy the most vibrant & historic area of the city!

After exploring all that Nashville has to offer, retreat to these quiet, relaxing condos! We’re located less than 20-minutes from the airport, less than a mile from Vanderbilt, a mile from Belmont, and just minutes from some of Nashville’s most renowned music venues & attractions. The home is fully equipped with all of the essentials, from towels to cooking supplies and anything else you might need during your stay. We hope to host you for your next visit to Music City!

**Note regarding the pool: The pool is open year round, but is not heated. It will be open and available during your stay, but the temperature of the water depends on the season. Fun fact, this unique guitar-shaped pool was built by country music legend Webb Pierce!

Guest access
You will have both Unit 1 and Unit 2 (two separate condos) all to yourself.

Other things to note
Early check in times selected through the app are not applicable. If you would like early check in, you must message us.
